trailhead.label: Frassenetto, Forni Avoltri, the board’s start

cautions: Heifers graze at Casera Vas in summer: close the electric fence gaps behind you and keep your dog on a short lead.
Long forest roads shared with forestry vehicles.
In winter the slope above the forest is steep and avalanches run near Casera Monte dei Buoi: summer walk only.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
